svg.data-output-rating: 15 A per C13; 16 A per C19; 16 A per section; 24 A total
svg.data-breakers: two 20 A two-pole breakers, one per section
svg.data-metering: current, power and energy for the input and each branch
svg.data-network-interface: hot-swappable meter module, RJ-45 network port, RJ-45 serial and daisy-chain ports, USB-A

g.data-description: Breaker A, 20 A two-pole: protects section A, outlets A1 to A6
g.title: breaker-a

g.data-description: Breaker B, 20 A two-pole: protects section B, outlets B1 to B6
g.title: breaker-b

g.data-description: the serial or environmental probe (EMP) RJ-45 port (quick start P-164000314_2, item 1); the upper of the stacked pair is an assumption (gaps: module-port-order)
g.title: serial

g.data-description: the daisy chain RJ-45 port (quick start P-164000314_2, item 9), under the chain symbol; the lower of the stacked pair is an assumption (gaps: module-port-order)
g.title: daisy-chain

g.data-description: the network RJ-45 port (the sheet prints a network symbol beside it)
g.title: network

g.data-description: the USB port under the network port, used for firmware upgrade (quick start P-164000314_2, item 8)
g.title: usb

g.data-description: the reset button of the network module: press it with a probe for 3 seconds to restart the module; it does not reset power to the outlets (quick start P-164000314_2, item 7)
g.title: reset
